Item.Name: S_PRODUCT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter product type, leave blank to query by bag id.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 counter number(4) ;
 v_bag_code varchar2(2) ;
 v_set_id number(4) ;
--HCL
/* HCL cursor c1 is
 select distinct bag_code, set_id
 from product_matrix
 where (:s_bag_code is not null and :s_product_code is null and
 bag_code = :s_bag_code )
 or (:s_product_code is not null and :s_bag_code is null and
 product_code = :s_product_code)
 or
 ( :s_bag_code is not null and :s_product_code is not null and
 bag_code = :s_bag_code and
 product_code = :s_product_code)
 order by bag_code,set_id ; */

--THE CURSOR BELOW HAS BEEN INTRODUCED BY HCL
 
CURSOR c1 IS
 SELECT distinct bag_code, set_id
 FROM product_matrix
 WHERE (:s_bag_code IS NOT NULL AND :s_product_type IS NULL 
 AND bag_code = :s_bag_code) 
 OR (:s_product_type IS NOT NULL AND :s_bag_code IS NULL 
 AND product_type = :s_product_type)
 OR (:s_bag_code IS NOT NULL AND :s_product_type IS NOT NULL 
 AND bag_code = :s_bag_code 
 AND product_type = :s_product_type)
 ORDER BY bag_code, set_id; 

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 go_block('set_list') ;
 clear_block(NO_COMMIT) ;
 open c1 ;
 counter := 0 ;
 loop
 fetch c1 into v_bag_code, v_set_id ;
 exit when c1%notfound ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 :bag_code := v_bag_code ;
 :set_id := v_set_id ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
if counter = 0 then
 GO_ITEM(name_in('system.trigger_field')) ;
 show_error('1266');
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
end if ;
first_record ;
go_block('product_matrix') ;
execute_query ;
go_block('set_list') ;
:s_highlighter := '=>' ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
--HCL if :s_product_code is null then
 IF :s_product_type IS NULL THEN --HCL
 if :s_bag_code is null then
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 else
 begin

/* HCL select product_desc into :s_product_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :s_product_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ; */

--THE SELECT STATEMENT BELOW HAS BEEN INTRODUCED BY HCL

 SELECT product_type_desc 
 INTO :s_product_type_desc
 FROM valid_product_types
 WHERE product_type_code = :s_product_type 
 AND sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,sysdate+365); 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
--HCL show_error('1205') ;
 show_error('1245'); --HCL
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if nvl(:delete_ind,'*') != 'X' then
 message('Err : Invalid action entered') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
else
 go_block('decision_blk') ; :ok_to_delete := 'N' ;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
then
 show_error('2159') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif :delete_ind is not null then
 message('Err: Please [COMMIT] action first') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
else
 :s_highlighter := ' ' ;
 next_record ;
 :s_highlighter := '=>' ;
 go_block('product_matrix') ;
 execute_query ;
 go_block('set_list') ;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_record = '1' then
 show_error('1700') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif :delete_ind is not null then
 message('Err: Please [COMMIT] action first') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
else
 :s_highlighter := ' ' ;
 previous_record ;
 :s_highlighter := '=>' ;
 go_block('product_matrix') ;
 execute_query ;
 go_block('set_list') ;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :ok_to_delete not in ('Y','N')
then
 show_error('0070') ; check_package_failure ;
elsif :ok_to_delete = 'N' then
 go_block('set_list') ;
 :delete_ind := '' ;
elsif :ok_to_delete = 'Y' then
 if :s_deleted = 'Y' then
 show_error('1267'); check_package_failure ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 begin
 delete from product_matrix
 where bag_code = :set_list.bag_code
 and set_id = :set_list.set_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :system.message_level := 5 ;

-- commit ;
 check_pass; -- Added by Edwin on 12.12.2001
 :system.message_level := 0 ;
 show_error('0000') ;
 go_block('product_matrix') ;
 loop
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 :s_dummy_2 := 'Deleted' ;
 exit ;
 end if ;
 :s_dummy_2 := 'Deleted' ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 go_block('set_list') ;
 :s_dummy_1 := 'Deleted' ;
 :s_deleted := 'Y';
 :delete_ind := '' ;
 :s_highlighter := '=>' ;
 end if ;
end if ;
